item: Replacement ATV tyres matched to the fleet's tyre sizes
rationale: Replacement ATV tyres were not available through normal channels in Resolute, and the XO had to negotiate a loan of two matching tyres and rims from a local contact. The brief's lesson is to identify ATV tyre sizes and specifications before departure and attempt to ship tyres via the Mars Society.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.6 Logistics and safety, lines 809-814, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 72 ('inner tubes or spare tyres')
